attributes.definition: Pay is tied to CPI, COLA, inflation, or a cost-of-living adjustment.
Pay changes by step, seniority, service time, or progression schedule.
Pay differs by rank, title, classification, grade, or job class.
Pay increases apply broadly across employees or a bargaining unit.
The document states a percentage raise or percentage wage adjustment.
Pay is linked to a market study, peer comparison, recruitment, or retention.
Pay is linked to parity, internal equity, compression, or alignment with another group.
Pay is described through CBA, settlement, memorandum, arbitration, or factfinding terms.
Pay depends on effective dates, retroactivity, schedules, or contract periods.
Pay is linked to budgets, funding, affordability, or municipal fiscal limits.
Evidence concerns benefits, overtime, stipends, longevity, leave, healthcare, pension, reimbursement, or equipment.
Evidence points elsewhere or supplies navigation/context rather than coded evidence.
Evidence lacks enough support for attribute classification in this phase; a reason code is required.
